newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania troubled bank to pay back small depositors.
newsitem.headline: Romania troubled bank to pay back small depositors.

text.p: Romania's troubled private bank Dacia Felix SA said it started reimbursements to small depositors on Wednesday, one year after it ceased payments over bad debts worth some $200 million and big losses.

"We want to cut some of our debts, so we started repaying principals and interest of up to 20 million lei to small individual clients," bank spokesman Ion Novacescu told Reuters by telephone from Cluj, the bank's Transylvanian headquarters.
Dacia Felix, once post-communist Romania's fastest growing private bank, is struggling with bad debts of some 2.2 trillion lei, owed mainly to the central bank (BNR).
Earlier this year the bank said it had posted a 33.2 billion lei profit in 1996 after 1995's 642.2 billion lei loss.
The bank still owes 1.7 trillion lei to the central bank and an extra 200 billion lei to state-owned commercial bank Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni, Novacescu said.
